import Mathlib

structure MaxMatchingGraph where
  left_size : Nat
  right_size : Nat
  adj : Array (Array Nat)

def MaxMatchingGraph.well_formed (g : MaxMatchingGraph) : Prop :=
  g.adj.size = g.left_size ∧
  ∀ u, u < g.left_size →
    ∀ v, v ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → v < g.right_size

def MaxMatchingGraph.has_edge (g : MaxMatchingGraph) (u v : Nat) : Prop :=
  u < g.left_size ∧
  v ∈ g.adj.getD u #[]

-- Matching definition
structure Matching where
  edges : List (Nat × Nat)

def Matching.is_valid (m : Matching) (g : MaxMatchingGraph) : Prop :=
  ∀ e, e ∈ m.edges → g.has_edge e.1 e.2

def Matching.is_disjoint (m : Matching) : Prop :=
  ∀ e1 e2, e1 ∈ m.edges → e2 ∈ m.edges → e1 ≠ e2 →
    e1.1 ≠ e2.1 ∧ e1.2 ≠ e2.2

def Matching.size (m : Matching) : Nat :=
  m.edges.length

def is_matching (g : MaxMatchingGraph) (m : Matching) : Prop :=
  m.is_valid g ∧ 
  m.is_disjoint ∧
  m.edges.Nodup

def is_max_matching_size (g : MaxMatchingGraph) (k : Nat) : Prop :=
  (∃ m, is_matching g m ∧ m.size = k) ∧
  (∀ m, is_matching g m → m.size ≤ k)

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def max_bipartite_matching_precond (graph : MaxMatchingGraph) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  graph.well_formed ∧ graph.left_size ≤ 1000 ∧ graph.right_size ≤ 1000
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
theorem decB {p : Prop} [Decidable p] : decide p = true ↔ p :=
  ⟨of_decide_eq_true, decide_eq_true⟩

theorem mem_arr_iff_mem_toList {a : Nat} {as : Array Nat} : a ∈ as ↔ a ∈ as.toList := by
  first
    | (simp; done)
    | exact Array.mem_def
    | exact Iff.rfl

theorem mk_has_edge (g : MaxMatchingGraph) (u v : Nat)
    (h1 : u < g.left_size) (h2 : v ∈ g.adj.getD u #[]) : g.has_edge u v :=
  And.intro h1 h2

theorem has_edge_parts (g : MaxMatchingGraph) (u v : Nat) (h : g.has_edge u v) :
    u < g.left_size ∧ v ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] := h

theorem mk_is_matching (g : MaxMatchingGraph) (m : Matching)
    (h1 : ∀ e, e ∈ m.edges → g.has_edge e.1 e.2)
    (h2 : ∀ e1 e2, e1 ∈ m.edges → e2 ∈ m.edges → e1 ≠ e2 → e1.1 ≠ e2.1 ∧ e1.2 ≠ e2.2)
    (h3 : m.edges.Nodup) : is_matching g m :=
  And.intro h1 (And.intro h2 h3)

theorem is_matching_parts (g : MaxMatchingGraph) (m : Matching) (h : is_matching g m) :
    (∀ e, e ∈ m.edges → g.has_edge e.1 e.2) ∧
    (∀ e1 e2, e1 ∈ m.edges → e2 ∈ m.edges → e1 ≠ e2 → e1.1 ≠ e2.1 ∧ e1.2 ≠ e2.2) ∧
    m.edges.Nodup := h

def edgeB (g : MaxMatchingGraph) (e : Nat × Nat) : Bool :=
  decide (e.1 < g.left_size ∧ e.2 ∈ (g.adj.getD e.1 #[]).toList)

def goodB (g : MaxMatchingGraph) (l : List (Nat × Nat)) : Bool :=
  decide ((∀ e ∈ l, edgeB g e = true) ∧
    (l.map Prod.fst).Nodup ∧ (l.map Prod.snd).Nodup)

def pairsWith (u : Nat) (vs : List Nat) : List (Nat × Nat) :=
  vs.map (fun v => (u, v))

def allEdgesAux (g : MaxMatchingGraph) : Nat → List (Nat × Nat)
  | 0 => []
  | n + 1 => pairsWith n ((g.adj.getD n #[]).toList) ++ allEdgesAux g n

def allEdges (g : MaxMatchingGraph) : List (Nat × Nat) :=
  allEdgesAux g g.left_size

def subseqs : List (Nat × Nat) → List (List (Nat × Nat))
  | [] => [[]]
  | a :: t => subseqs t ++ (subseqs t).map (fun s => a :: s)

def candidates (g : MaxMatchingGraph) : List (List (Nat × Nat)) :=
  (subseqs (allEdges g)).filter (goodB g)

def maxMatchSize (g : MaxMatchingGraph) : Nat :=
  ((candidates g).map List.length).foldr max 0

    (h_precond : max_bipartite_matching_precond graph) : Nat :=

  -- !benchmark @end code

  -- !benchmark @end postcond

theorem inj_of_nodup_map {α β : Type} {f : α → β} {l : List α} (d : (l.map f).Nodup) :
    ∀ x ∈ l, ∀ y ∈ l, f x = f y → x = y := by
  induction l with
  | nil => intro x hx; simp at hx
  | cons a t ih =>
    simp only [List.map_cons, List.nodup_cons] at d
    intro x hx y hy hxy
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp hx with hx' | hx'
    · rcases List.mem_cons.mp hy with hy' | hy'
      · rw [hx', hy']
      · exfalso
        apply d.1
        rw [hx'] at hxy
        rw [hxy]
        exact List.mem_map.mpr ⟨y, hy', rfl⟩
    · rcases List.mem_cons.mp hy with hy' | hy'
      · exfalso
        apply d.1
        rw [hy'] at hxy
        rw [← hxy]
        exact List.mem_map.mpr ⟨x, hx', rfl⟩
      · exact ih d.2 x hx' y hy' hxy

    (H : ∀ x ∈ l, ∀ y ∈ l, f x = f y → x = y) (d : l.Nodup) : (l.map f).Nodup := by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp
  | cons a t ih =>
    simp only [List.nodup_cons] at d
    simp only [List.map_cons, List.nodup_cons]
    refine And.intro ?_ (ih ?_ d.2)
    · intro hmem
      obtain ⟨y, hy, hfy⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hmem
      have hay : a = y := H a (by simp) y (by simp [hy]) hfy.symm
      rw [hay] at d
      exact d.1 hy
    · intro x hx y hy hxy
      exact H x (by simp [hx]) y (by simp [hy]) hxy

theorem nodup_of_nodup_map {α β : Type} {f : α → β} {l : List α}
    (h : (l.map f).Nodup) : l.Nodup := by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp
  | cons a t ih =>
    simp only [List.map_cons, List.nodup_cons] at h
    simp only [List.nodup_cons]
    refine And.intro ?_ (ih h.2)
    intro hmem
    exact h.1 (List.mem_map.mpr ⟨a, hmem, rfl⟩)

theorem edgeB_iff (g : MaxMatchingGraph) (e : Nat × Nat) :
    edgeB g e = true ↔ g.has_edge e.1 e.2 := by
  unfold edgeB
  rw [decB]
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact mk_has_edge g e.1 e.2 h.1 (mem_arr_iff_mem_toList.mpr h.2)
  · intro h
    have h' := has_edge_parts g e.1 e.2 h
    exact And.intro h'.1 (mem_arr_iff_mem_toList.mp h'.2)

theorem goodB_iff_aux (g : MaxMatchingGraph) (l : List (Nat × Nat)) :
    goodB g l = true ↔
      ((∀ e, e ∈ l → g.has_edge e.1 e.2) ∧
        (l.map Prod.fst).Nodup ∧ (l.map Prod.snd).Nodup) := by
  unfold goodB
  rw [decB]
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact And.intro (fun e he => (edgeB_iff g e).mp (h.1 e he)) h.2
  · intro h
    exact And.intro (fun e he => (edgeB_iff g e).mpr (h.1 e he)) h.2

theorem goodB_iff (g : MaxMatchingGraph) (m : Matching) :
    goodB g m.edges = true ↔ is_matching g m := by
  rw [goodB_iff_aux]
  constructor
  · intro h
    refine mk_is_matching g m h.1 ?_ (nodup_of_nodup_map h.2.1)
    intro e1 e2 h1 h2 hne
    refine And.intro ?_ ?_
    · intro hEq
      exact hne (inj_of_nodup_map h.2.1 e1 h1 e2 h2 hEq)
    · intro hEq
      exact hne (inj_of_nodup_map h.2.2 e1 h1 e2 h2 hEq)
  · intro h
    have hp := is_matching_parts g m h
    refine And.intro hp.1 (And.intro ?_ ?_)
    · refine nodup_map_of_inj ?_ hp.2.2
      intro x hx y hy hxy
      by_contra hne
      exact (hp.2.1 x y hx hy hne).1 hxy
    · refine nodup_map_of_inj ?_ hp.2.2
      intro x hx y hy hxy
      by_contra hne
      exact (hp.2.1 x y hx hy hne).2 hxy

    ∀ a b : Nat, a < n → b ∈ (g.adj.getD a #[]).toList → (a, b) ∈ allEdgesAux g n := by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro a b ha _
    exact absurd ha (Nat.not_lt_zero a)
  | succ k ih =>
    intro a b ha hb
    simp only [allEdgesAux, List.mem_append]
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge a k with h | h
    · exact Or.inr (ih a b h hb)
    · have h' : a = k := by omega
      subst h'
      refine Or.inl ?_
      unfold pairsWith
      exact List.mem_map.mpr ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩

    (h1 : e.1 < g.left_size) (h2 : e.2 ∈ (g.adj.getD e.1 #[]).toList) :

  induction h with
  | slnil => simp [subseqs]
  | cons a h ih =>
    simp only [subseqs, List.mem_append]
    exact Or.inl ih
  | cons₂ a h ih =>
    simp only [subseqs, List.mem_append]
    exact Or.inr (List.mem_map.mpr ⟨_, ih, rfl⟩)

theorem foldr_max_zero_or_mem (L : List Nat) : L.foldr max 0 = 0 ∨ L.foldr max 0 ∈ L := by
  induction L with
  | nil => exact Or.inl rfl
  | cons a t ih =>
    rcases max_choice a (t.foldr max 0) with h | h
    · refine Or.inr ?_
      simp only [List.foldr_cons, h]
      simp
    · simp only [List.foldr_cons, h]
      rcases ih with h0 | hm
      · exact Or.inl h0
      · exact Or.inr (by simp [hm])

theorem le_foldr_max (L : List Nat) : ∀ x ∈ L, x ≤ L.foldr max 0 := by
  induction L with
  | nil => intro x hx; simp at hx
  | cons a t ih =>
    intro x hx
    simp only [List.foldr_cons]
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp hx with h | h
    · rw [h]; exact le_max_left _ _
    · exact le_trans (ih x h) (le_max_right _ _)
-- !benchmark @end lemma

    (h_precond : max_bipartite_matching_precond graph) :
    max_bipartite_matching_postcond graph
